Since $\overset{―}{kv}=\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v},$ we get the following equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{kv} & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{v} \\ [\begin{aligned}4\text{i}-12 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}-2\text{i} \\ 0\end{aligned}]} \\ [\begin{aligned}4\text{i}-12 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{-2\text{i}} \\ \overset{―}{0}\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}4\text{i}-12 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =\overset{―}{k}\,[\begin{aligned}2\text{i} \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}4\text{i}-12 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2\text{i}\,\overset{―}{k} \\ 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we obtain that 

$$
2\text{i}\,\overset{―}{k}=4\text{i}-12\,⟹\,\overset{―}{k}=\frac{4\text{i}-12}{2\text{i}}=2+6\text{i}.
$$

 

Therefore, $k=\overset{―}{2+6\text{i}}=2-6\text{i}.$

Finally, $\text{Im}(k)=-6.$
